title: Of course the ChatGPT dog cancer vaccine spawned a startup
slides: A vaccine trained by AI cured a dog's cancer. Where was it?
The secret: ChatGPT-style learning adapted to tumor proteins.
The dog lived, but the AI made one wrong prediction first.
Now a startup will sequence your pet's tumor in days.
Ask your vet for genomic testing before your next biopsy.
thread_text:
1. Where was it?

A vaccine trained by AI cured a dog's cancer in a clinical trial in the US.

2. The secret method

ChatGPT-style learning adapted to tumor proteins made the vaccine personalized for each dog.

3. One wrong guess

Before success, the AI made a false prediction about the tumor, showing the risk of overconfidence.

4. Faster now

A startup now sequences your pet's tumor in days, not weeks, using the same AI approach.

5. Ask your vet

Before your next biopsy, request genomic testing to see if this vaccine could help your pet.

instagram.caption:
A clinical trial just used an AI-trained vaccine to cure a dog's cancer — and the same tech is now a startup. 🐕💉

The AI learned from tumor proteins, not text, to build a personalized vaccine for each dog. It made one wrong prediction early on, a reminder that this is still trial-and-error. Now a company will sequence your pet's tumor in days instead of weeks.

If you're a pet owner, this changes your next vet visit: ask for genomic testing before any biopsy. It's the difference between guessing and targeting.

Would you ask your vet for a genomic test on your dog's lump next week? 🔬

carousel_slides.description: A US clinical trial used an AI-trained vaccine to cure a dog's cancer. The vaccine was personalized for each dog.
The vaccine adapted ChatGPT-style learning to tumor proteins, making it personalized for each dog's unique cancer.

A new startup uses the same AI approach to sequence your pet's tumor in days, not weeks, enabling faster treatment decisions.
